old_value: {"id":"jmap-chat-spec-ka7b","title":"ChatContact.id: server-assigned Id; new identity property","description":"Mark decided 2026-10-18 (mimid J1-J6 gap 3): ChatContact.id MUST be an RFC 8620 Id (server-assigned, [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}); /get takes ids: Id[] and user@host / DID / URI strings are not Ids. Raw identity (user@host, DID, MIMI user URI, any URI) moves to a new immutable server-set ChatContact property 'identity'. Two layers: clients use local ChatContact.id; the federation wire carries identity strings (senderUserId, readerUserId, Peer/groupUpdate members/removed/role ids, ownerUserId, Mention ids in Peer/deliver payloads), receivers map identity -\u003e local id; identity binding compares authenticated identity directly. Rejected: hash-derived ids (not routable/resolvable: a receiver cannot create a usable placeholder for an unknown member hash, Fed L514); reusing login (display fallback, deployment-formatted). Sites: base L216-217, 349-353, 423-426, 460, 467, 889, 1424-1434, 1472-1484; federation L155,161,191,217,352,402,462,500,514-523; mimi-00 L424 (hub contact: server-assigned id, identity = login = provider URI); ~270 refs across companion drafts and guides need classifying. Do after crate-jmap JMAP-yt1w run finishes (base draft is its normative text). Mark commits.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-19T03:07:17.815827632Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-19T03:07:17.815827632Z"}
new_value: {"notes":"Mark decisions 2026-10-18 on gaps found by the spec pass (wf_2bc7061e-393): (1) Owner's local id = the JMAP accountId (single-user mailbox; already a server-assigned Id clients have from Session). Used wherever a client-facing user reference means the owner (members, Mention.id, removeMembers self-leave, hasMention, SpaceBan, Space self-removal/self-nick). No ChatContact may have the accountId as its id. Federation identity-mapping step 1 maps the owner's identity to accountId. Open: whether senderId/reaction-key \"self\" stays or becomes accountId. (2) ChatContact/set create takes only identity; server assigns id; existing identity -\u003e alreadyExists with existingId (RFC 8620 5.3); ChatContact/query gains an identity filter. Compliance 7.9/13.2 restored to test this. (3) Rich-body mention span userId: spans are display-only; server never maps or rewrites body; only the mentions array is mapped/authoritative. Revert the base-draft span example change if it implied mapping; drop the federation body-rewrite carve-out. (4) Federation general rule: every user-reference field a spec defines (incl. companion action metadata like tasks-00 assigneeIds) carries identities between servers; receivers that don't recognise a field pass it through unmapped; tasks-00 points to it."}
